convertibility_reason: Uses custom indicator BlauTVI via iCustom() and external .mqh include for trade management (CTrade class). Custom indicator logic cannot be auto-converted without replicating the TVI calculation in Python.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction
Trailing stop adjusts SL to breakeven+trail when price moves favorably by TrailingStop pips

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size (absolute value used); Positive Lots value = fraction of free margin (Lots/100) used for volume calculation with margin check

custom_logic_notes: BlauTVI is William Blau's Trend Vigor Index - a custom indicator measuring trend strength and direction. Signal is zero-line crossover: positive TVI = bullish, negative TVI = bearish. The EA reverses position on opposite signal (closes opposite side, then opens new). Trailing stop only activates when TrailingStop>0. Position sizing uses conditional logic: negative input = fixed lots, positive input = fraction of free margin (Lots percent). The EA uses previous completed bar values (shift=1) for signal detection to avoid repainting.
external_dependencies: BlauTVI.ex5 (custom indicator required in Indicators folder)
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate BlauTVI custom indicator calculation in Python - it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The TVI (Trend Vigor Index) by William Blau involves double-smoothed momentum calculations. Position sizing conditional logic (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be preserved. The digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP/Trail by 10 for 5/3-digit) must be handled. New bar detection is essential - only one trade decision per completed bar. Signal uses bar index [1] (previous completed bar) to avoid repainting.
